taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-09 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-09
Curve type: HA
Aquifer depth: 1.86 – 24.59 m
Recommendation: Target the moderate-resistivity zone (552.4 ohm-m) between ~1.9 m and ~24.6 m depth as the primary water-bearing layer; case off the shallow resistive top layer and set screens within this interval, noting the thin resistive layer below (24.6–25.8 m) as a possible confining/transition zone before reaching the deeper high-resistivity basement-like unit.
